name: Hashum
overview: The name Hashum appears in Scripture as an important figure connected to the Jewish community returning from exile, identified both as an ancestor and a leader. The children of Hashum are listed among the returning exiles, numbering over two hundred (Ezra 2:19) and later more than three hundred (Nehemiah 7:22), indicating a significant family group. Hashum is also recognized as a priest and a head of a family, evidenced by his presence among key leaders standing beside Ezra the scribe (Nehemiah 8:4) and his mention in the covenant signatories (Nehemiah 10:18). These references highlight Hashum's role in the restoration and spiritual leadership of the post-exilic community.
